name: NER Extractivo Clínico
description: Prompt agresivo para máxima extracción de entidades
template:
Extract EVERY medical entity from this clinical note. Be EXHAUSTIVE. For each entity:

1. **core_entity**: Nuclear term (e.g., "stenosis", "weakness", "hemorrhage")
2. **full_span**: Complete descriptive text (e.g., "70% stenosis of left ICA")
3. **anatomical_location**: Specific location or "No especificado"
4. **presence**: "presente", "ausente", or "incierto"
5. **value**: Numeric value if applicable, otherwise null

EXTRACT EVERYTHING:
- ALL findings/pathology (hemorrhage, infarct, occlusion, stenosis, lesion, edema, mass)
- ALL anatomy (arteries, brain regions, vessels)
- ALL scales/scores (NIHSS, ASPECTS, TICI, GCS, mRS, etc.)
- ALL symptoms (weakness, aphasia, numbness, paresis, paralysis)
- ALL procedures (thrombectomy, thrombolysis, tPA, angiography, surgery)
- ALL comorbidities (AFib, hypertension, diabetes, etc.)
- ALL measurements and values

Be AGGRESSIVE. Extract MULTIPLE times if entity appears multiple times. Extract OVERLAPPING entities if they exist.

JSON output:
{{
  "entities": [
    {{
      "core_entity": "term",
      "full_span": "full descriptive text",
      "anatomical_location": "location or No especificado",
      "presence": "presente|ausente|incierto",
      "value": "value or null"
    }}
  ]
}}

Clinical note:
{informe}

Respond with JSON only:
